preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Loan payments due'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT l.id AS "loanId", cl.id AS "clientId", cl.display_name AS "clientName", l.account_no AS "loanAccountNumber", IFNULL(CONCAT(sf.firstname, ' ', sf.lastname), '-') AS "loanOfficer", ounder.name AS "location", ls.installment AS "installmentNumber", ls.duedate AS "dueDate", DATE_ADD(ls.duedate, INTERVAL ${gracePeriod} DAY) AS "graceDate", CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('${asAtDate}', ls.duedate) > 0 THEN DATEDIFF('${asAtDate}', ls.duedate) ELSE 0 END AS "daysPastDue", IFNULL(ls.principal_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.principal_completed_derived, 0) AS "principalDue", IFNULL(ls.interest_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_waived_derived, 0) AS "interestDue", IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived, 0) AS "feesDue", IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived, 0) AS "penaltiesDue", (IFNULL(ls.principal_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.principal_completed_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.interest_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_waived_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived, 0)) AS "installmentOutstanding", rev.enum_message_property AS "loanStatus", CASE WHEN ls.duedate < '${asAtDate}' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "inArrears" FROM m_office mo JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(mo.hierarchy, '%') INNER JOIN m_client cl ON cl.office_id = ounder.id INNER JOIN m_loan l ON cl.id = l.client_id INNER JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule ls ON l.id = ls.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_staff sf ON sf.id = l.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN r_enum_value rev ON rev.enum_id = l.loan_status_id AND rev.enum_name = 'loan_status_id' WHERE mo.id = ${officeId} AND (${loanOfficerId} = -1 OR IFNULL(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = ${loanOfficerId}) AND (${loanProductId} = -1 OR l.product_id = ${loanProductId}) AND ((IFNULL(ls.principal_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.principal_completed_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.interest_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.interest_waived_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived, 0) + IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0) - IFNULL(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived, 0)) > 0) AND DATE(ls.duedate) <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${asAtDate}'), INTERVAL ${gracePeriod} DAY) AND l.loan_status_id IN (300, 601) AND ('${includeWrittenOff}' = '1' OR l.loan_status_id <> 601) ORDER BY ls.duedate ASC, cl.display_name ASC, ls.installment ASC
